Promoter's notes

The fundamentals
  • Promos raise a wrestler's popularity, especially when their charisma is high.
  • Matches draw better when popular wrestlers meet and their styles complement each other.
  • Being left off television hurts morale. Losing can hurt too.
  • Fair salaries stabilize morale, but payroll comes due after every show.
  • Ticket prices that are too high will empty your 250-seat studio.
